description: This file defines a FormatterService class that provides headless code formatting using VSCode's formatting providers. It creates temporary files, applies formatting edits, and cleans up. It also includes a helper function for formatting content based on file path.

classes.name: FormatterService
classes.description: Singleton class providing methods to format code content headlessly using VSCode's formatting providers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FormatterService.

methods.name: generateTempFilePath
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary file path adjacent to the target file, maintaining the extension.

methods.name: applyEditsToString
methods.description: Applies a list of vscode.TextEdit objects to a string content, in reverse order to avoid offset issues.

methods.name: formatContent
methods.description: Formats raw content using VSCode's formatting providers via a temporary file, with fallback to raw content on failure.

methods.name: formatContentForFile
methods.description: Resolves a file path and formats the content based on the file's location and type.
